name: sentry
description: Connects the site's error tracking to Sentry through the Sentry provider plugin in the same package (observability-sentry). Ships the know-how and a secure key card: the person pastes the project's DSN and an optional environment name; the host saves it to your project, and you choose which sites use it. No Sentry code here; the provider plugin reports the errors.
author: Tovu

jini.summary: Sends your site's errors to Sentry. Ask the assistant to add error tracking.

credentialCards.title: Connect Sentry
credentialCards.label: Sentry
credentialCards.intro: Send this site's errors to Sentry.
usedFor: Reports server errors and slow requests to your Sentry project
credentialCards.keyHint: In Sentry open Project settings → Client Keys (DSN) and copy the DSN.
